hero.caption: What remains of the Freeport Roller Mill and Miller's House in Freeport, Minnesota, USA. The house remains standing, but the original mill (also known as the Swany White Mill) burned down on December 27, 2011 and all that remains is the stone chimney in the background; the gray building in between is not a part of the NRHP listing.

images.caption:
Swany White Flour Mills: rear view of the mill's original powerhouse smokestack (left), a modern building constructed to replace the 1898 mill lost in a 2011 fire (center), and the 1900 miller's house (partially visible on right).  Viewed from the southwest.
